entities.summary: Claude Earl "Chuck" Rayner, nicknamed "Bonnie Prince Charlie", was a Canadian professional hockey goaltender who played nine seasons in the National Hockey League for the New York Americans and New York Rangers. He is a member of the Hockey Hall of Fame. Chuck Rayner was a athletes & competitors from Saskatoon (1920-08-11, Saskatoon–2002-10-06). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
